$comment: Whether the sprint process is running. Paused is a real state, not an absence of one: scripts must say so rather than presenting a stale sprint as active.
reason: Finish the application first. Sprint ceremony over an incomplete product measures the ceremony.
stillActive: All specialist agents, invoked and sequenced the same way: discuss, implement, review, then record the verdict
The release gate, deploy gate, line-ending check and agent validator — these are safety controls, not ceremony, and are never paused
The backlog, as the record of what is left; only the weekly ritual around it stops
resumeCondition: The vertical slice CS-16 to CS-19 is usable end to end and 3.0.1 hardening is verified in CI, not locally.
